title: Projectile visuals: data trails, bolt halos, spin from data, terrain impacts, pooled lights and materials
player_outcome: Gem bolts, sparks, Starfury stars, the Enchanted Sword beam and flaming arrows leave coloured trails. Magic bolts glow with a halo. Shuriken spin flat, boomerangs whirl flat, bombs tumble. Arrows thunk into walls with dust. Fishing bites splash and plop.
design: Verified: ProjectileDef.Trail has zero readers. Bolts are SphereMesh radius Def.Radius*0.25 with a new material and OmniLight each (ProjectileRenderer.cs:264-285). Spin only when Returns > 0 || Fuse, end over end (line 222). fish_bite.wav is unused.
ProjectileDef: Spin (rad/s, default 0), SpinAxis ('tumble' | 'flat' | 'roll'), TrailWidth (m, 0.12), TrailTime (s, 0.25).

Split ProjectileRenderer.cs into ProjectileRenderer.cs (lifecycle), ProjectileRenderer.Visuals.cs (Create: meshes, bolt halos, cached materials Dictionary<Color, Material>) and ProjectileRenderer.Trails.cs.

Trails: one shared ImmediateMesh. Each projectile has a 12-point ring buffer sampled at 60 Hz, drawn as camera-facing tapered strips (additive, alpha fade), with dying trails kept for TrailTime after Removed. Buffers are pooled.
Bolts: core radius ≥ 0.06 m plus an additive halo billboard (radius×4).
Remove the per-projectile OmniLight. ProjectileRenderer.Lights(eye, radius) becomes a DynamicLights provider that tracks the projectile, so the count is limited by the preset pool.
Core ProjectileSystem: event HitTerrain(Projectile, Vector3 point, ushort block), raised in MoveThroughTerrain on collision (once per bounce).
SoundEvents plays 'arrow_hit' for Visual 'arrow', else dig_{material} at −6 dB. EffectKit fires 4 chips in the block colour.
Fishing: ProjectileRenderer detects the Biting rising edge → Sfx.PlayAt('fish_bite') plus an EffectKit Splash.

Projectiles: flaming_arrow gets a trail if missing; 'trail' colours kept
tests: ArsenalTests: an arrow fired into a wall raises HitTerrain exactly once

verification: Lavapipe screenshot of amethyst_staff bolts and a thrown shuriken
perf: 60 bolts on screen → gd.projectiles < 1 ms, draw calls not scaling with bolt count
risks: Overlaps P1 lag item D5 (per-projectile materials/OmniLights) in the same file; whichever lands second rebases.
Trail ribbons on very fast bullets can stretch; cap segment length.
